jobs.title: Director Solutions Delivery (Finance)
jobs.description:
Location:
Vancouver, BC | Open to relocation

A leading fashion retailer based in Vancouver, BC
is seeking a Director, Solution Delivery, Finance Technology to lead the execution and ongoing evolution of enterprise Finance technology solutions.

Day to Day
Lead delivery of enterprise Finance technology solutions across SAP ECC/S/4HANA, financial close, P2P, tax, reporting, and integrations
.
Partner closely with Finance leadership to translate business needs into technology solutions and execute against the Finance technology roadmap.
Oversee implementations, configuration, integrations, testing, deployment, and L2/L3 escalations
, including month-end support.
Lead technology teams and vendors while managing budgets, contracts, delivery commitments, and platform performance.
Drive continuous improvement, automation, and responsible use of AI across Finance processes.
Operate as a techno-functional delivery leader
, solving complex business and technical problems without being hands-on in the code.

Must-Haves
Senior leadership experience delivering enterprise Finance technology/ERP solutions
.
Strong understanding of Finance processes
and the technology supporting them.
Experience with SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA
and large-scale ERP implementations or transformations.
Strong techno-functional
background with enterprise applications, configuration, integrations, and L2/L3 support.
Experience partnering with senior Finance stakeholders and leading cross-functional technical teams.
Strong vendor, budget, and enterprise technology delivery management experience.

Plusses
Big 4 consulting
experience.
S/4HANA transformation experience.
Experience with SOX, financial controls, audit, and data governance.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, AI, or intelligent automation.

Compensation:
$200,000-$300,000 CAD annually plus annual bonus.
Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.
AI Disclosure:
Artificial intelligence tools are used to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position.
Vacancy Disclosure:
This role is for a new vacant opening within a new project.

Director

Industries
